abstract: A 22-year-old man was referred to our hospital for a lung tumor on a chest X-ray examination. Computed tomography of the chest revealed multiple coin lesions. Magnetic resonance imaging of the left testis showed an 8-mm tumor that was hard and palpable. Testicular tumor with lung metastasis was diagnosed and orchiectomy was performed. The histopathological diagnosis was embryonal carcinoma with infiltration of histiocytes. Four days after the operation, a chest X-ray showed a remarkable regression of the lung tumors. Chemotherapy was not performed because the metastatic lesions continued to regress spontaneously. Six months later, no tumor was observed on computed tomography images of the lungs.
abstract_ja: 22歳の男性が、胸部X線検査で肺腫瘍を指摘され当院を紹介受診した。胸部CTで多発する円形病変が認められた。左精巣のMRIでは8mmの硬く触知可能な腫瘍が認められた。精巣腫瘍と肺転移と診断し、精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的診断は、組織球浸潤を伴う胎児性癌であった。術後4日目の胸部X線で、肺腫瘍の著明な退縮が認められた。転移巣が自然に退縮し続けたため、化学療法は施行しなかった。6か月後、肺のCTでは腫瘍は認められなかった。
